summary: Well‑executed, fully preregistered paired confirmatory run that faithfully implemented shared_initial_candidate semantics and deterministic validator scoring. The manuscript transparently reports a degenerate null result (200/200 valid in both arms), documents preregistration and artifacts, and correctly bounds interpretation to the executed estimand (downstream validator/repair effect on a fixed sampled candidate). Materials, accounting, and mandatory master‑prompt provenance are present in the evidence bundle.
optional_revisions: Ensure the References section contains full IEEE‑style bibliographic entries (authors, title, venue, year) rather than identifier‑only lines (DOI/arXiv) so each cited record can be independently verified from the paper body.

Add a single, very brief item in Conclusion reiterating that the preregistered primary estimand was intentionally limited by shared_initial_candidate semantics and that independent per‑condition sampling would constitute a different preregistered estimand (to avoid any residual reader confusion).

Consider including a one‑line summary table in Results that explicitly lists repair_attempt_count = 0 and repair_applied_count = 0 (artifact paths/hashes already archived) to make the degenerate pathway immediately visible in the paper text.
